author: OpenAI
description:
At Sullivan & Cromwell LLP, John Savva uses Codex to build tools around the firm’s legal expertise.

Agreement Analyzer brings together a draft agreement, selected precedents, and playbooks reflecting the firm’s and client’s positions. It identifies potential issues and returns a memo and proposed tracked changes for a lawyer to review.

Lawyers can inspect the sources and explanations behind the findings, then accept, revise, or reject the proposed changes before advising the client.

Watch John explain the workflow, and read the full story: https://openai.com/index/sullivan-cromwell/
title: How Sullivan & Cromwell builds legal tools with Codex | OpenAI

“We see Astra actually show over double digit gains over any other model we've tested on two fronts.”

Hebbia’s Kavita Anand names the two: selecting the right sources and generating PowerPoint presentations.

For a banker or investor working through a data room with thousands of documents, both matter. The research needs to draw from the right evidence, and the deck needs to follow the user’s guidelines before it informs an investment decision.

Watch Kavita explain what Hebbia found in its evaluations.
title: Hebbia on Astra: Better research, better presentations | OpenAI
